title: Fuchsia City Gym Leader
threat_analysis: Koga's Classic Hard Mode lineup combines evasive status attrition with explosive physical and special threats. Venomoth/Grimer leads with STAB Sludge Bomb and Disable to lock down counters. Magnemite/Koffing threatens Levitate-protected electric coverage and a catastrophic Self-Destruct. Beedrill/Scyther boosts speed with Agility and fires Technician-boosted Pin Missile and Poison Jab. His Ace, Chansey/Muk, is a colossal 180+ HP tank holding Black Sludge that stacks Acid Armor physical defense and Double Team evasion while rapidly decaying your team with badly poisoned Toxic tick damage.
tactical_counter_plan: Bulbasaur Team Strategy: Venusaur/Fearow quad-resists Bug and Grass while completely ignoring Toxic Spikes and Ground moves; STAB Drill Peck cleanly OHKOs Beedrill/Scyther and Venomoth/Grimer. Kadabra/Haunter outspeeds Chansey/Muk and dismantles it with STAB Psychic before Acid Armor stacks.

Charmander Team Strategy: Charizard/Kadabra incinerates Beedrill/Scyther and Venomoth/Grimer with STAB Flamethrower and cleanses Poison types with STAB Psychic. Primeape/Sandslash or Dugtrio/Arbok absorbs Electric moves and punishes with high-velocity Ground power.

Squirtle Team Strategy: Blastoise/Fearow easily outspeeds and crushes Bug/Poison foes with Drill Peck while Roost neutralizes chip. Dugtrio/Primeape eliminates Magnemite/Koffing with Sucker Punch and Cross Chop, while Kadabra/Haunter obliterates Chansey/Muk with super-effective Psychic.
Countering Toxic & Evasion: Equip Pecha Berries or Lum Berries to ignore turn-1 Toxic. Use moves that bypass evasion or defeat Chansey/Muk with Special Psychic moves before Double Team spirals.
rewards: Soul Badge (Enables use of Surf in field, boosts Pokémon Defense)
